test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two trains are moving in the same direction at 60 km/h and 42 km/h. The faster train crosses a man in the slower train in 36 seconds. Find the length of the faster train.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of faster train = 60 km/h

Speed of slower train = 42 km/h

Time taken to cross the man = 36 seconds

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Speed of faster train - Speed of slower train

Length of faster train = Relative speed × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 60 km/h - 42 km/h

⇒ Relative speed = 18 km/h

Convert 18 km/h to m/s:

1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

⇒ 18 km/h = 18 × 5/18 m/s

⇒ 18 km/h = 5 m/s

Length of faster train = Relative speed × Time taken

⇒ Length = 5 m/s × 36 s

⇒ Length = 180 m

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
